about: Golden bodies of the email and jobs routes (Protocol E11, GitHub #13250): what coax/web/api/email.c answers on POST /api/admin/email and coax/web/api/jobs.c on POST /api/jobs/<job>, with the status each came with. `from` says where a body's bytes came from. api: a running API answered them in coax/web/api/test.sh (test_email.py and test_jobs.py with OPS_CAPTURE, on a build host, 2026-11-12), at the commit before the codecs, on a throwaway database with a fake mail service and a fake token check. caller: a request test_email.py sends. The same tests hand every body of every run to this check (--read-all). The refusals of /api/admin/email's sign-in gate (Log in first., Admins only.) are api.c's, answered before email.c is reached. A day that ran before answers its stored result as jsonb's text. No run answered an auth-sweep result: the job fails on the suite's database, so its result is held by jobs-wire.coax's own checks only. coax/web/api/ops-wire-goldens.coax holds each body's keys to its message and reads it through email-wire.coax or jobs-wire.coax and writes it back for the same bytes.
